messages.text: customer says export to CSV gives an empty file. known thing, happens when the date range is over 90 days. it's not actually empty, the job times out at 30s and we only write the header row. workaround: split into ranges under 90 days OR use the API export which has no limit (needs an admin token tho). fix is planned for 4.12, no date yet. also seen on the PDF export but only for accounts with more than 50k rows i think?? not confirmed

facts.quote: export to CSV gives an empty file

answer.label: Troubleshooting
answer.title: CSV export file is empty

items.text: The <f1>CSV export file is empty</f1> when the <f2>date range is over 90 days</f2>.
The <f3>job times out at 30s</f3> and the file <f4>contains only the header row</f4>.
<f5>Split the export into date ranges under 90 days.</f5>
Use the <f6>API export</f6>, which has <f7>no limit</f7>. <f8>You'll need an admin token.</f8>
A fix is <f9>planned for version 4.12</f9>, <f10>release date TBC</f10>.
The <f11>PDF export</f11> may also be affected for accounts with <f12>over 50,000 rows</f12>. <f13>Status not confirmed.</f13>

questions: Is the date range check on the start date, the end date, or both?
Does the API export also time out at 30s, or is it asynchronous?
How does a user get an admin token?
Is there a link to the API documentation?
Is there a separate KB article for the PDF export issue?
